clue.text: Chaste priest leading strike within church

indicators.note: within means the priest-and-strike pair sits inside the church abbreviation

parts.note: CE is the Church of England

indicators.note: leading means the priest comes in front of the strike

parts.note: Eli is the priest who raised Samuel in the Bible
to bat is to strike a ball

explanation.surface: A celibate clergyman heading a walkout inside his own church.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who abstains from sex is chaste, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Carried over, being unwanted

indicators.note: over says the word for carried is turned back to front

parts.note: ported means carried, as a rifle is

explanation.surface: Something brought forward to the next page turns out to be surplus.
explanation.walkthrough: DE TROP is a French borrowing used in English for someone or something superfluous.
explanation.definitionFit: The French phrase means too much, so in the way and not wanted.

clue.text: A conclusion in final document that's driven by race

indicators.note: in places the A and conclusion inside the final document

parts.note: a will is the last document a person signs
a term is an end or limit

explanation.surface: An ending tucked into a last testament, with a cryptic tag about racing.
explanation.walkthrough: A mill race is the channel of water that turns a mill wheel, so 'race' is not a contest.
explanation.definitionFit: A water-powered mill is turned by the current flowing along its millrace.

clue.text: Where swine lives empty life, in a way

parts.note: a sty is a pig's pen

indicators.note: empty means the word life loses its contents, keeping only its ends

explanation.surface: A pig's pen described as a hollow existence, in some fashion.
explanation.definitionFit: A style is a manner or way of doing something.

clue.text: Notes hard to harmonise

parts.note: me (mi) is a note of the sol-fa scale; mes are several of them
H is the pencil abbreviation for hard

explanation.surface: Musical notes that are difficult to fit together in harmony.
explanation.definitionFit: Things that mesh fit together smoothly, like gear teeth, a verb synonym.

clue.text: Slovenly girls need belts

indicators.note: slovenly means messy, so the letters of girls need are untidily rearranged

explanation.surface: Untidy young women require a belt to hold up their clothes.
explanation.definitionFit: To engirdle is to encircle as with a girdle, so belts as a verb fits.

clue.text: Hand out commendation from police officer?

indicators.note: from shows the commendation comes from the officer, the officer's name in front

parts.note: DI is a Detective Inspector; police officer's gives DI'S
a tribute is an expression of praise

explanation.surface: A query: is praise from a detective something you hand out?
explanation.definitionFit: To distribute is to share or hand out among people.

clue.text: Backsliding seaman gets working shortly

indicators.note: backsliding means the seaman abbreviation slides back to front

parts.note: OS is an ordinary seaman
on means working, as a machine is

explanation.surface: A lapsed sailor soon finds work again.
explanation.definitionFit: Soon and shortly both mean before long, a synonym.

clue.text: Remaining Socialist

definitions.meaning: what is still there after the rest is gone

explanation.surface: A socialist who stays put.
explanation.definitionFit: Things still there are left over; socialists are on the political left.

clue.text: Dwarf kangaroo, one of seventy or so?

parts.note: baby as an adjective means miniature, as in baby carrots
a boomer is a large male kangaroo in Australian usage

explanation.surface: A tiny kangaroo, then a question about age.
explanation.walkthrough: Baby boomers, born in the post-war birth surge of 1946 onwards, were about seventy when this ran.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone born after the Second World War was around seventy years old by the 2010s, hence the question mark.

clue.text: During calm days, Bill sang in the evening

indicators.note: During puts the bill inside the word for calm

parts.note: serene means calm
an ad (advertisement) is a bill or poster

explanation.surface: Bill passed peaceful days singing in the evenings.
explanation.definitionFit: A serenade is music sung at evening, typically under a lover's window.

clue.text: Even Democrat succeeded in this country

indicators.note: in puts succeeded inside this country

parts.note: for a British newspaper, this country is the UK
S is the genealogical abbreviation for succeeded

explanation.surface: A Democrat doing just as well in Britain.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Even' looks like an adjective but is the poetic noun for evening.
explanation.definitionFit: Even is an old poetic word for evening, the time of twilight.

clue.text: Church official's wife shunned by worker coming to join?

indicators.note: shunned by means the wife is dropped from the worker

parts.note: a welder joins metal pieces

explanation.surface: A churchman whose wife is avoided by a workman joining up.
explanation.definitionFit: In Presbyterian churches an elder is a lay office-holder.

clue.text: The ring fashioned without gold's not so good

indicators.note: without means outside, so the rearranged letters go around the gold
fashioned means shaped anew, so the letters of The ring are reworked

parts.note: Au is the chemical symbol for gold

explanation.surface: A ring made without gold is a lesser thing.
explanation.definitionFit: Naughtier is the comparative of naughty, worse behaved.

clue.text: Bond introduced to stimulate the reader

indicators.note: introduced to says the letters are set within the words stimulate the reader

explanation.surface: James Bond brought in to excite readers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bond' suggests 007, but it is a noun for a tie.
explanation.definitionFit: A tether is a rope that ties an animal, a kind of restraining bond.

clue.text: Ball stopping short in extremely lush greenery

indicators.note: in puts the shortened ball inside the word for extremely

parts.note: very means extremely

indicators.note: stopping short means the dance loses its last letter

parts.note: a ball is a formal dance

explanation.surface: A ball broken off amid very rich green surroundings.
explanation.definitionFit: Verdancy is the quality of being green with growth, lush vegetation.

clue.text: Jersey, perhaps with large hood

indicators.note: with joins the large abbreviation after the animal

parts.note: a Jersey is a breed of dairy cow
L is the clothing-size abbreviation for large

explanation.surface: A jersey sweater with a big hood attached.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Jersey' reads as a sweater; it is the cattle breed from the Channel Island.
explanation.definitionFit: A cowl is a monk's hood, or any loose hood.

clue.text: Promises to pay? First lie detector wrongly rejects one

indicators.note: wrongly means the letters of first lie detector are mixed up
rejects says one letter is thrown out of the mixed letters

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A lie detector's first reading goes wrong and rejects someone.
explanation.definitionFit: Letters of credit are bank guarantees of payment, documents promising to pay.

clue.text: The woman's behind food served up for townsfolk

indicators.note: behind puts the woman's after the food
served up means in a down clue the food word is turned upwards, read backwards

parts.note: grub is slang for food
hers means belonging to the woman

explanation.surface: The woman sits behind the food dished out for local people.
explanation.definitionFit: Burghers are citizens of a town, the townsfolk.

clue.text: Weak drug for you in the past

parts.note: thin means weak, like watery soup
E is ecstasy

explanation.surface: A feeble drug meant for you back then.
explanation.definitionFit: Thine is the archaic form of yours, meaning belonging to you in old usage.

clue.text: Confirm result's about right

indicators.note: about means the result goes around the right abbreviation

parts.note: to ensue is to result or follow

explanation.surface: Checking that a result is about right.
explanation.definitionFit: To ensure is to make certain, to confirm.

clue.text: Body that examines soil brought back in the course of space assignment

indicators.note: in the course of puts the reversed soil inside the space

parts.note: room means space

indicators.note: brought back means the soil word is read backwards

parts.note: clay is a heavy soil
a mission is an assigned task

explanation.surface: Soil samples returned during a space mission.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests moon rock; 'space' is just room.
explanation.definitionFit: A royal commission is a formal public inquiry set up to investigate an issue.

clue.text: Friendly remark misled Lateran spy

indicators.note: misled means led astray, so the letters of Lateran spy wander into a new order

explanation.surface: A spy at the Lateran (the Pope's Rome palace) deceived by a friendly word.
explanation.definitionFit: A pleasantry is a polite, amiable comment.

clue.text: Crafty nurses understanding only a little

indicators.note: nurses means holds closely, so crafty goes around understanding

parts.note: sly means crafty
light means enlightenment, understanding

explanation.surface: Cunning nurses who understand very little.
explanation.definitionFit: Slightly means to a small degree, a little.

clue.text: Youngster needs drinks, holding party with little money

indicators.note: holding means the drinks wrap around the party

parts.note: ales are beers, so drinks
a do is a party
a cent is a coin of small value

explanation.surface: A young person wants drinks at a party with no cash.
explanation.definitionFit: An adolescent is a teenager, a young person.

clue.text: Putting up planks

explanation.surface: Erecting a run of planks.
explanation.definitionFit: Boarding means lodging people, and also timber boards collectively.

clue.text: Bowl given out as somewhere to put your ash?

parts.note: in lawn bowls, a bowl is called a wood
shed means cast off or given out

explanation.surface: A bowl offered as an ashtray.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ash' suggests cigarettes; it is the tree, timber kept in a woodshed.
explanation.definitionFit: A woodshed stores firewood, which may include ash logs.

clue.text: Course for which Egyptian's evacuated plane, possibly

indicators.note: evacuated means emptied, keeping only the first and last letters of Egyptian

parts.note: the plane is a tree, as in London plane

explanation.surface: An Egyptian leaves an aircraft during a meal course.
explanation.walkthrough: 'plane' reads as an aircraft but is the tree.
explanation.definitionFit: An entree is a dish served as a course of a meal.

clue.text: Two last in line prompted to go up

indicators.note: to go up means in a down entry the pieces read upwards
last in takes the final letter of line

parts.note: cued means prompted, as an actor is

explanation.surface: Two people at the back of the queue told to step up.
explanation.definitionFit: A deuce is a two in cards or dice.

clue.text: Artist tipped gracious host

indicators.note: tipped means tipped over, so the artist abbreviation is turned round

parts.note: RA is a Royal Academician
my and gracious are both exclamations of surprise

explanation.surface: An artist gave a tip to a generous host.
explanation.walkthrough: 'host' is not a party-giver but a multitude.
explanation.definitionFit: A host is a great multitude, especially an army.
